### Researcher & Co-Author
Urban Science  
[2026]{.when}

**Estimating the Impact of High-Frequency Public Transit on Employment Outcomes in Chicago Neighborhoods**

- Built a tract-level panel dataset combining GTFS, ACS, and LEHD/LODES data.
- Implemented fixed-effects difference-in-differences and event-study models.
- Conducted bootstrap inference, placebo analyses, alternative specifications, and robustness checks.
- Evaluated model assumptions and compared alternative analytical approaches.

**Core strengths demonstrated:** causal analysis, statistical modeling, data integration, model evaluation, robustness analysis, and research communication.
